Software Services Agreement

Agreement No. NW-2026-0417 · Effective 1 November 2026

This Software Services Agreement is entered into by and between Northwind Software Ltd., a company registered in Ireland, and Contoso Logistics GmbH, a company registered in Germany.

2. Fees and Payment

Customer shall pay a monthly subscription fee of EUR 4,800 for up to 250 named users, plus EUR 18 per additional user. Invoices are issued on the first business day of each month and are payable within thirty (30) days. Late payments accrue interest at 1% per month.

The initial term is twenty-four (24) months from the Effective Date and renews automatically for successive twelve-month periods unless either Party gives ninety (90) days written notice.

3. Українською

Замовник сплачує щомісячну абонентську плату в розмірі 4 800 євро за до 250 користувачів. Рахунки виставляються першого робочого дня кожного місяця.
